# Rochester Beacon

> Rochester Beacon is a nonprofit local news organization providing narrative journalism, analysis, and opinion on complex challenges facing Rochester, New York.

Founded by Evan Dawson and Alex Zapesochny, Rochester Beacon delivers fact-grounded investigative reporting on local politics, policy, and community issues. The organization operates with editorial independence following Institute for Nonprofit News standards and actively engages the community through events and partnerships.

## Key Topics

- Rochester, New York
- Local news
- Nonprofit journalism
- Democratic primary
